title: Revenue feature: bring-a-friend tiered pricing
body:
Owner: @janellereonal
Target: Nov 1 first shared pricing code;Nov 4 integration;Nov 7 edge cases.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Provider-entered buddy rate optional per session;null disables;positive and below normal offer.
- [ ] Shared quote/booking function selects buddy for quantity>=2 in same session/transaction;standard otherwise.
- [ ] Server never trusts client rate/type and never oversells allocated seats.
- [ ] Receipt stores normal offer,charged rate,pricing type,quantity,fee and payout.
- [ ] Test quantity 1/2/3,disabled rate,insufficient seats,price change and later offer edits.
- [ ] No stacking or paid add-ons. Maps to brief tiered-pricing option.

Follow docs/routes.md,docs/schema.md and docs/business.md; reviewed code PR required.
